integrity.external_mathematical_premise: Published conjugacy and Fatou-component classification, without independent rederivation.
integrity.proof_basis: Symbolic skew-product conjugacy from arXiv:2611.08773v1 plus elementary toral-kernel and Burnside counting; standalone finite checks provided.

scientific_limitations: Only the Fletcher–Martin map f_{d,m} on the three-sphere with d,m>=2 and 1/d+1/m<1. The claim counts distinct fixed and periodic points, not multiplicities or every map of that degree. Classical Lattès priority comparison is not exhaustive.
title: Exact periodic-point census and zeta functions for a Cantor-sphere Julia set
